All 57 `keep_attrs` tests and both `where` tests pass.

The fix: instead of passing a lambda that always returns `x.attrs` (which overwrites coordinate attrs with data variable attrs), we use `"override"` for the `apply_ufunc` call (which correctly preserves coordinate attrs from the input objects), then explicitly set `result.attrs = getattr(x, "attrs", {})` to ensure data variable attrs come from `x`. This handles both the original #6461 scalar case (scalar `x` has no `.attrs`, so we get `{}`) and this #7229 regression (coordinate attrs are no longer overwritten).
